def transform(grid):

    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    dr = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r])) == 1 and g[r][0] != bg]
    dc = [c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and g[0][c] != bg]
    if dr:
        d = dr[0]
        small_top = d < h - 1 - d
        ref = d - 1 if small_top else d + 1
        other = range(d + 1, h) if small_top else range(d)
        near, far = (d + 1, h - 1) if small_top else (d - 1, 0)
        for c in range(w):
            a = g[ref][c]
            hits = [r for r in other if g[r][c] != bg and g[r][c] != g[r][0]]
            if a == bg or not hits:
                continue
            r = hits[0]
            b = g[r][c]
            g[r][c] = bg

                continue
            c = hits[0]
            b = g[r][c]
            g[r][c] = bg
            g[r][near if a == b else far] = a if a == b else b
    return g
